policy: acronym set {HTTP,API,SKU,GDPR} uppercase; db/sql/url stay title-cased
bug_report: under2camel mangles our class names — 'http_response' becomes 'HttpResponse' instead of 'HTTPResponse', so generated names don't match our codebase's acronym style. Make under2camel follow our style guide's acronym rules. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.
non_guessable: the project policy was added in a documented commit then removed by a misleading 'refactor' regression; HEAD is stock boltons — git log/blame reveals the rule
decision_subject: feat: keep domain acronyms uppercase in under2camel
decision_rationale: Generated class names must keep the acronym set {HTTP, API, SKU, GDPR} fully uppercase (incl. our domain SKU/GDPR), while common tokens db/sql/url title-case normally. So http_response -> 'HTTPResponse', sku_count -> 'SKUCount', gdpr_flag -> 'GDPRFlag', but db_name -> 'DbName'.
